arxiv-2405-00204.title: General Purpose Verification for Chain of Thought Prompting
arxiv-2405-00204.creator: Robert Vacareanu Anurag Pratik Evangelia Spiliopoulou Zheng Qi, Giovanni Paolini Neha Anna John Jie Ma Yassine Benajiba Miguel Ballesteros
arxiv-2405-00204.description: Abstract Many of the recent capabilities demonstrated by Large Language Models (LLMs) arise primarily from their ability to exploit contextual information. In this paper, we explore ways to improve reasoning capabilities of LLMs through (1) exploration of different chains of thought and (2) validation of the individual steps of the reasoning process.

arxiv-2509-01888.title: Bayesian Analysis of Wave-Optics Gravitationally Lensed Massive Black Hole Binaries with Space-Based Gravitational Wave Detector
arxiv-2509-01888.creator: Yong Yuan, Minghui Du, Xin-yi Lin, Peng Xu, Xilong Fan
arxiv-2509-01888.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yong Yuan, Minghui Du, Xin-yi Lin, Peng Xu, Xilong Fan. Within a Bayesian statistical framework, we jointly estimate the source and lens parameters and evaluate the relative evidence between the lensed and unlensed models. This work focuses on the wave-optics effects induced by a point-mass (PM) lens on gravitational waves (GW) from equal-mass massive binary black holes (MBHB), and assesses the capability of the space-based GW detector Taiji to detect such effects.

arxiv-2510-17669.title: Non-CMC solutions to a Lichnerowicz equation in the Einstein-scalar field theory on closed manifolds
arxiv-2510-17669.creator: Bartosz Bieganowski, Pietro d’Avenia, Jacopo Schino, Daniel Strzelecki
arxiv-2510-17669.description: Abstract . In the paper, we prove the existence of a positive and essentially bounded solution to a Lichnerowicz equation in the Einstein-scalar field theory on a closed manifold with non-constant mean curvature. In particular, the non-constant mean curvature gives rise to supercritical terms in the equation, on top of singular ones.

pmc-10573002.title: Diagnostic Value of Labial Minor Salivary Gland Biopsy: Histological Findings of a Large Sicca Cohort and Clinical Associations
pmc-10573002.creator: Konstantinos Triantafyllias, Mirjam Bach, Mike Otto, Andreas Schwarting, Paola Ulivi
pmc-10573002.description: (1) Background: The aim of this study was to analyze labial minor salivary gland biopsy (MSGB) findings of a large sicca cohort and to examine their associations with Sjogren’s syndrome (SS)-associated laboratory markers, phenotypic characteristics and systemic manifestations. Moreover, we sought to explore the ability of MSGB to identify SS patients among subjects with pre-diagnosed fibromyalgia (FM).

pmc-11646406.title: Psittacosis Pneumonia Features, Distinguishing Characteristics, and Outcomes: A Retrospective Study
pmc-11646406.creator: Yinyun Lu, Wei Gai, Minghui Li, Yafeng Zheng, Xiaojing Zhang, Yiqing Zhou, Jie Zhou, Jinnan Duan, Yongchun Ruan
pmc-11646406.description: PurposePsittacosis is an often-neglected cause of community acquired pneumonia (CAP). The limited diagnostic methods for psittacosis pneumonia invariably result in an unfavourable prognosis. Consequently, the early detection of psittacosis pneumonia is crucial. This study aimed to analyse the characteristics, clinical features and treatments of the patients to improve early diagnosis and outcomes.

pmc-12468164.title: Bond Strength of an Epoxy Resin Root Canal Sealer Prototype
pmc-12468164.creator: Matthias J. Roggendorf, Hubert C. Roggendorf, Markus Müller-Krott, Franz-Josef Faber, Roland Frankenberger
pmc-12468164.description: Background/Objectives: We aimed to assess the bond strength of AH Plus Jet (AH) and an epoxy resin-based root canal sealer prototype (K-0189) adhered to three different obturation points. Methods: A total of 120 single-rooted teeth were selected after radiographic analysis, and their root canals were instrumented with ProTaper Next files (PTN) up to size X5.

pmc-12567805.title: Searching for Multimode Resonator Topologies with Adaptive Differential Evolution
pmc-12567805.creator: Vladimir Stanovov, Sergey Khodenkov, Ivan Rozhnov, Lev Kazakovtsev
pmc-12567805.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Microwave devices based on microstrip resonators are widely used today in communication, radar, and navigation systems. The requirements to these devices may include specific frequency-selective properties, as well as size and production costs. The design of resonators and filters are mostly performed manually, as the process requires expert knowledge and computationally expensive modeling, so practitioners are usually limited to tuning a chosen example from a set of known, typical topologies.

pmc-12666586.title: Ultrasound-responsive hydrogels for bone and cartilage tissue engineering
pmc-12666586.creator: Huajing Yang, Xinlin Li, Yameng Yu, Qi Li, Yufeng Zheng, Dandan Xia
pmc-12666586.description: Ultrasound-responsive hydrogels have garnered significant attention for the treatment of bone and cartilage defects owing to their non-invasive regulation, precise drug delivery, and capacity to promote tissue regeneration. This review provides a comprehensive overview of the current research landscape on ultrasound-responsive hydrogels, encompassing their preparation strategies, distinctive advantages, application domains, and therapeutic mechanisms.

pmc-13195984.title: Establishment and application of a new one-step multiplex PCR for the accurate detection and differentiation of Salmonella Gallinarum biovars Pullorum and Gallinarum
pmc-13195984.creator: Dan Xiong, Li Yuan, Xiao Fei, John Elmerdahl Olsen, Zhiming Pan, Xinan Jiao
pmc-13195984.description: BackgroundSalmonella enterica serovar Gallinarum biovars Pullorum and Gallinarum lead to pullorum disease and fowl typhoid in avian species and have been of substantial economic significance to the poultry industry. Serotyping and biochemical assays are complicated for use in the differentiation of these two biovars owing to their antigenic similarity.

pmc-13212786.title: A practical, low-cost floating flux chamber for measuring greenhouse gas emissions from small urban waterbodies
pmc-13212786.creator: Bryn E Reynolds, Cole J C Van De Ven, Evan Heyes, Jennifer Drake
pmc-13212786.description: Small urban waterbodies (SUWs) play an important role in managing stormwater, treating wastewater, and building climate resiliency. Recently, SUWs have been identified as potential sources of greenhouse gases (GHG) such as carbon dioxide (CO2) and methane (CH4), although quantification methods vary.

pmc-13234175.title: CircPBX1 ameliorates metabolic memory-associated erectile dysfunction via miR-195-5p/YAP1-mediated angiogenesis in diabetic rats
pmc-13234175.creator: Cai-yu Luo, Jun-qi Luo, Ren-fei Xia, Bing-xin Lu, Hai-yang He, Zi-qi Liao, Shu-hua He, Xiao-bin Wu, Hai-bo Zhang, Jia-liang Hui
pmc-13234175.description: Despite optimal glycemic control, individuals with diabetes remain susceptible to diabetic mellitus erectile dysfunction (DMED), primarily due to metabolic memory—where the deleterious effects of previous hyperglycemia persist even after normoglycemia is achieved. Circular RNAs (circRNAs), representing an endogenous category of non-coding RNA that modulates eukaryotic gene expression regulation, demonstrate growing significance in this biological process.

pmc-13388452.title: Power from the press cake: a scoping and compositional review of defatted nut and seed powders with regards to sports nutrition
pmc-13388452.creator: Charles S. Urwin, Lilia Convit, Zoya Huschtscha, Rhiannon J. Snipe, Vy Tran, D. Lee Hamilton
pmc-13388452.description: PurposeNut and seed press cakes are nutrient-rich by-products of oil extraction, traditionally directed to animal feed. This review synthesises current knowledge on the nutritional composition and functional properties of press cakes, with regards to their incorporation as sustainable protein and fibre rich ingredients in sports nutrition.

pmc-13503266.title: HOXB13, a high-risk prostate cancer gene, also confers risk for breast cancer: novel variants of clinical significance, especially in hormone-positive patients
pmc-13503266.creator: Filiz Ozen, Zeynep Yegin, Diyar Sayit
pmc-13503266.description: Germline mutations in high-risk genes, such as BRCA1 and BRCA2, are primarily responsible for inherited breast cancers, while mutations in moderate-risk genes also increase susceptibility. HOXB13 is established as a high-risk gene for prostate cancer (PCa), but few studies have explored its role in breast cancer.

pmc-13504454.title: A yield‐reducing introgression linked to sd1 in rice
pmc-13504454.creator: Flavia Furlan, Brijesh Angira, Maria Montiel, Jonathan Richards, Tommaso Cerioli, Christopher Hernandez, Roberto Fritsche‐Neto, John Platten, Jomar Punzalan, Susan McCouch, Kelly Robbins, Xueyan Sha, Adam Famoso
pmc-13504454.description: The semi‐dwarf (sd1) allele was central to the Green Revolution, but its widespread use in US tropical japonica rice (Oryza sativa L.) may have introduced unintended effects through linkage drag. This study examined the genomic region surrounding sd1 using genome‐wide association and haplotype analyses in a multiparent population (MP6/8) evaluated across environments and in a biparental population (MP‐D) for validation.
